name: Illuminati Adventure
summary:
Prepare yourself for an idle adventure to become a billionaire capitalist in the Illuminati realm! The incremental idle game where you start from the very bottom, clearing streets and investing your hard earned cash into a lemonade stand, to end with constructing the New World Order. Begin with finding a way to upgrade your lemonade stand into the great idle factory producing lemonade. Start incrementing money from your business, advance in your career and get rich by hiring managers. Do everything to attract attention of Illuminati overlords, they like rich magnates.

Illuminati Adventure is an idle incremental game with clicker mechanics, the idle game that shows the cruelty of the capitalistic world and shows how billionaires' minds are exposed to corruption.
